title: Anthropic reports $17 billion in Q3 revenue, purchase commitments of $895.4 billion in revised S-1
summary: Anthropic unveiled its S-1 prospectus last week, but the initial filing only included the company's financials through the first half of the year.

title: New York Times and other outlets sue web browser Brave over alleged content scraping
summary: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused web browser company Brave for allegedly scraping the outlet’s copyrighted content and unlawfully distributing it to its own customers, like Anthropic and Perplexity.
title_en: New York Times and Other Outlets Sue Brave Over Alleged Content Scraping
title_zh: 《纽约时报》等媒体起诉浏览器Brave涉嫌抓取内容
summary_en: The New York Times is suing privacy-focused browser Brave, alleging it scraped the outlet's copyrighted content and unlawfully distributed it to customers like Anthropic and Perplexity.
summary_zh: 《纽约时报》起诉隐私浏览器Brave，指控其抓取受版权保护的内容并非法分发给Anthropic、Perplexity等客户。

title: Deep Principle Releases Hydrogen-1.0: A 753B Open-Weight Model for Scientific Discovery
summary: Deep Principle has released Hydrogen-1.0, an open-weight scientific model for chemistry, materials science and life sciences. It is built by post-training Z.ai’s GLM-5.3 on domain data, laboratory records and agent discovery trajectories. For developers, it offers open weights that report a FrontierScience-Research win over GPT-6-Astra. The weights ship under the MIT License. TL;DR What is […] The post Deep Principle Releases Hydrogen-1.0: A 753B Open-Weight Model for Scientific Discovery appeared first on MarkTechPost .
title_en: Deep Principle Releases Hydrogen-1.0: A 753B Open-Weight Model for Scientific Discovery
title_zh: Deep Principle发布Hydrogen-1.0：7530亿参数开源科学发现模型
summary_en: Deep Principle released Hydrogen-1.0, a 753B open-weight model for chemistry, materials and life sciences, post-trained from Z.ai's GLM-5.3 on lab records and agent trajectories. It ships under MIT License and reports a FrontierScience-Research win over GPT-6-Astra.
summary_zh: Deep Principle发布Hydrogen-1.0，这是一个7530亿参数的开源科学模型，面向化学、材料与生命科学，基于GLM-5.3在实验室数据和智能体轨迹上后训练，采用MIT许可证，并称在FrontierScience-Research评测中胜过GPT-6-Astra。

title: The New York Times sues Brave web browser for AI scraping and bypassing paywalls
summary: The New York Times and a group of other publications have filed lawsuits against the company that makes the Brave web browser over alleged unlawful scraping to train AI and also letting users bypass their paywalls, as reported by Reuters. According to a complaint filed by the New York Daily News, the Chicago Tribune, and […]
title_en: New York Times Sues Brave Browser Over AI Scraping and Paywall Bypass
title_zh: 纽约时报起诉Brave浏览器：AI抓取与绕过付费墙
summary_en: The New York Times and other publications sued Brave's maker, alleging unlawful scraping to train AI and enabling users to bypass paywalls, per Reuters. The complaint was filed by the New York Daily News, Chicago Tribune and others.
summary_zh: 纽约时报等多家媒体起诉Brave浏览器开发商，指控其非法抓取内容用于训练AI，并允许用户绕过付费墙。诉状由纽约每日新闻、芝加哥论坛报等提交。

title: Raising the quality of insights in agentic analytics
summary: In just a few years, generative AI has changed the face of enterprise analytics, notably by making analytics accessible to users across the organization. Agentic AI promises to do even more, by automating entire workflows and taking actions based on agent insights. But there is a problem: The quality of insights that agents currently generate…
title_en: Raising the Quality of Insights in Agentic Analytics

summary_en: Generative AI has democratized enterprise analytics, and agentic AI promises to automate entire workflows and act on insights. However, the quality of insights agents currently generate remains a significant problem.
summary_zh: 生成式AI已让企业分析普及化，智能体AI有望自动化整个工作流并基于洞察采取行动，但目前智能体生成的洞察质量仍是重大问题。
